shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- routing/top ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- toast docs ---\\n' && rg -n -i -C 5 'toast' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package dirs ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type d \\( -name docs -o -iname '*toast*' \\) -print; printf '%s\\n' '--- toast symbols ---'; rg -n --glob '*.d.ts' --glob '*.md' --glob '*.js' 'Toast|toast\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist 2>/dev/null | head -220; printf '%s\\n' '--- trap button ---'; rg -n -C 4 'Button view|toast' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider/provider dts ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterProvider/ToasterProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; printf '\\n--- root exports ---\\n'; rg -n 'ToasterProvider|toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- versioned docs ---\\n'; curl -L --max-time 15 -s https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt | rg -n -i -C 8 'ToasterProvider|useToaster|toaster\\.' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export .*toaster|toaster-singleton' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/*.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js; printf '\\n--- component positioning/biding ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js; printf '\\n--- button api ---\\n'; rg -n 'button.*@gravity|@gravity.*Button|toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/index.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'toaster-singleton|ToasterProvider|ToasterComponent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts'; printf '\\n--- package exports/read me setup ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; find . -path '*node_modules*' -prune -o -type f \\( -iname '*toast*' -o -name 'README.md' \\) -print 2>/dev/null | head -30; jq '.peerDependencies,.dependencies,.exports' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc "command -v apply_patch || true; find / -type f -name 'apply_patch*' 2>/dev/null | head -20; git status --short; sed -n '1,80p' src/main.tsx; sed -n '1,80p' src/App.tsx"
